name: beethoven-qa
description: Write Python to the Beethoven engine's definition of done and bring existing modules up to it: skills for contracts, layered runtime types and the CrossHair/Z3 gate, a build-stream agent that works in its own worktree, the gate-until-green, verify-module and improve-module workflows, and a hook that says at once what the code standards would block in each file a session edits.
